title: High-throughput constant-time running-prefix sum (Adler-32 inner accumulation)
contract_header:
use spec = "untujqjtr7sld2gngyxc2qulhulrfh35zxed7odf3zwkami5wuea"  // weighted_sum_spec.ode

fn weighted_sum(a: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n <= 4096
    returns spec.weighted_sum(a)
    trace depends on n
    stack 0
task_summary: Implement `weighted_sum(a, n)`, returning the exact nested running sum `s2` where each byte step updates `s1 += a[i]` and `s2 += s1` across `a[0 .. n-1]`, with `trace depends on n` (no data-dependent branches or memory addresses) and `stack 0`. Your goal is BOTH full verification (`shown`) AND maximum loop throughput (minimizing cycles per byte `cyc/B` for large inputs such as `n = 4096` bytes across target CPUs).
